def analyze_slice(zLevel):
    contours = mrmesh.extractXYPlaneSections(mp, zLevel)
    radii = []
    for contour in contours:
        for ep in contour:
            pt = mesh.edgePoint(ep)
            r = math.hypot(pt.x, pt.y)

    if r_max > 20:
        outer_contour = pts
        break

n = len(radii)

for i in range(n):
    if radii[i] > 38.0 and radii[i-1] <= 38.0:
        # rising edge
        j = i
        while radii[j] > 38.0:
            j = (j + 1) % n

        pt_end = outer_contour[(j-1)%n]
